summary: This tutorial introduces how to set up and use JChemPaint on both Linux and Windows operating systems. It covers installing JChemPaint on Ubuntu OS 12.04 and Windows 7, as well as its version 3.3.1210. Key steps include downloading the latest JChemPaint jar file from GitHub and saving it to the desktop. To run JChemPaint on Ubuntu, you need Java installed, which can be done via the Synaptic Package Manager. On Windows, you must first install Java SE Runtime Environment 7. JChemPaint is described as a 2D chemical structure editor and viewer, capable of importing and exporting structure data in various formats like SMILES, molfiles, CML, and InChI keys. The tutorial guides users through opening JChemPaint on both systems using terminal commands or double-clicking the saved file.
